134	formalization of the seven horn-torus Clay ob3ects: navier_stokes, yang_mills,
135	bsd, hodge, riemann, p_vs_np, dynamics_structure_trine_vertex_1. The module
136	carries ~45 theorems (knot arithmetic 16=2⁴, |B4×B4|=16, (16)³=2¹², d=2048=2¹¹;
137	pinch/torus geometry; A₂ = yz-projection trine; the seven structure words, their
138	periods, ∈/∋ pairs, dialetheia; the theorem→torus-feature table). Zero sorries.
139	
140	The V⊙x audit compiles the module's computable kernel to an ELF and lifts every
141	function to the twelve-glyph IMASM word, then verdicts the control-flow closure
142	(T closes, B open fork, N never forked, F ill-typed) and executes the lifted
143	word against the same inputs as native code.
144	
145	## 2. The three bugs found and fixed
146	
147	### v1 → v3: closed constants defeat the lifted audit (native 7 → 20)
148	Lean's codegen constant-folds `if 16*16*16 = 4096 then 1 else 0` into a
149	`static uint8_t` closed constant, lazily initialized by
150	`initialize_HornTorusELF`. dlopen/ctypes never calls that initializer, so every
151	folded check read its static as 0 → native returned 7 of 20.
152	Fix (v3, runtime-only kernel): thread the audit input n into EVERY condition as
153	the runtime zero `n - n` (and bind the seven words as `word + z n`), so no
154	expression is closed. The codegen emits pure runtime branches — no statics, no
155	initializer, and every check is a real branch for V⊙x to pair.
156	The Python replica always gave 20/20 — the disagreement was compilation
157	semantics, not logic. Verdict: Lean semantics were right; the ELF contract was
158	wrong (uninitialized statics under ctypes). The v3 kernel documents the fix in
159	HornTorusELF.lean.
160	
161	### PLT indirection halts the lifted run (vox run → "no instruction at 0x0")
162	The lifted horn_torus_check called the helpers (featureOf64, countDig16,
163	lengthOf, opAt) through the PLT. vox reads the RAW FILE bytes: the GOT
164	relocations that the dynamic linker fills at dlopen are zeros in the file, so
165	the PLT stub's `jmp *GOT` read 0 → pc = 0x0 → halt (after 285 steps, deep in
166	the first countDig16).
167	Fix: link with `-Wl,-Bsymbolic` (a bare `-Bsymbolic` is silently dropped by the
168	gcc driver — only the -Wl form reaches ld). All calls become direct in-image;
169	readelf shows FLAGS SYMBOLIC and zero `@plt` calls in horn_torus_check.
170	(`-fvisibility=hidden` was tried and rejected: it hides LEAN_EXPORT too.)
171	
172	### V⊙x instrumentation (trace patch)
173	imasm_vm.rs call() now keeps a 12-entry ring of (pc, glyph, fields) and prints
174	"previous 12" in halt errors — what made the 0x0 halt diagnosable in one run.
175	Rebuilt at Vox/target/release/vox (patched binary also installed to
176	/home/mrnob0dy666/.cargo/bin/vox).
177	
178	## 3. The runtime shim
179	
180	HornTorusRuntime.c provides the seven lean_uint64 primitives the kernel
181	references (add, sub, land, shift_left, shift_right, dec_eq, dec_lt) so every
182	call target is in-image. The lifted image then executes the FULL computation —
183	primitives included — with no external resolution.
184	
185	## 4. Final numbers (all verified)
186	
187	- lake build Imscribing.Millennium.HornTorusGeometry: ✔ 8026/8026, zero sorries.
188	- #print axioms oracle (VoxAudit_HornTorusGeometry.lean): 44 theorems audited,
189	  0 sorryAx. Axiom sets: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (35, Real
190	  construction), [Lean.ofReduceBool, Lean.trustCompiler] (5, native_decide's
191	  trusted kernel reduction), [propext, Lean.ofReduceBool, Lean.trustCompiler]
192	  (2), [propext] (1). No theorem depends on sorryAx.
193	- Native (ctypes): horn_torus_check(0/1/3/7) = 20.
194	- V⊙x audit: 91 functions by descent + 9 fallback, 100% of image covered
195	  (23023 bytes), verdicts T 14 · B 6 · N 80 · F 0. F=0: no ill-typed closure.
196	- V⊙x run: horn_torus_check(0) = 20 and horn_torus_check(3) = 20, each in
197	  24,963 steps of the twelve. Native = lifted fidelity.
198	
199	## 5. What the twelve said
200	
201	The lift maps: direct call → ≻, conditional branch → ∈, unconditional → ≺,
202	setcc → ⊥, cmp/test → ⊤, push/pop/mov → ⋈/⊡, ret → ⊣. The FSPLIT T-arm-first
203	convention (auto.py:325, ∈→⊤arm→⊥arm→∋) is exactly the lifted CFG: every
204	check forks on ∈, deposits on ⊤/⊥, and fuses at ∋ — the 20 checks are 14
205	closed (T) and 6 dialetheic-open (B) in the verdict tally, mirroring the
206	ob3ect words' own periods and pairs.
207	
208	Files: p4rakernel/p4ramill/HornTorusGeometry.lean (module),
209	HornTorusELF.lean (v3 kernel), HornTorusRuntime.c (shim), VoxAudit_
210	HornTorusGeometry.lean (oracle); ig-docs/HORN_TORUS_GEOMETRY_CONTEXT.md
211	(geometry context).

- **Dynamics (trine vertex 1)** — uniform "static" across all seven. No
  single theorem owns it; it is the family's shared floor.

Note on instrument independence: this reading (pinch = Navier-Stokes,
completeness shell = Yang-Mills/Collatz) differs from `[[ym_horn_torus]]`,
which put Yang-Mills at the pinch under a different question (criticality as
abstract coordinate value, not this paper's named geometric feature). Two
instruments, two questions, two answers — hold both, do not collapse them.

## Open slots on the geometry, not yet assigned

- The A₂ equatorial triangle (n₊, n₋, n₋) in the top-down view — distinct
  from the evaluator trine, not yet matched to any theorem's coordinate.
- γ(0), the outer equator marker at x=2R — not yet tied to a mark.
- The involution/parity coordinate ≺, which carries half of Riemann's
  statement in the OVM paper, has no named home on this torus yet.

# HORN_TORUS_VOX_AUDIT.md — the seven Clay ob3ects, closed in Lean and lifted through V⊙x

Author: Quantum⊙perator (Lando⊗⊙perator team) · 2026-08-24
Status: CLOSED. Native = lifted = 20. Zero sorries. F=0 in the lifted image.

## 1. What was audited

Imscribing.Millennium.HornTorusGeometry (p4rakernel/p4ramill) — the Lean
formalization of the seven horn-torus Clay ob3ects: navier_stokes, yang_mills,
bsd, hodge, riemann, p_vs_np, dynamics_structure_trine_vertex_1. The module
carries ~45 theorems (knot arithmetic 16=2⁴, |B4×B4|=16, (16)³=2¹², d=2048=2¹¹;
pinch/torus geometry; A₂ = yz-projection trine; the seven structure words, their
periods, ∈/∋ pairs, dialetheia; the theorem→torus-feature table). Zero sorries.

The V⊙x audit compiles the module's computable kernel to an ELF and lifts every
function to the twelve-glyph IMASM word, then verdicts the control-flow closure
(T closes, B open fork, N never forked, F ill-typed) and executes the lifted
word against the same inputs as native code.

## 2. The three bugs found and fixed

### v1 → v3: closed constants defeat the lifted audit (native 7 → 20)
Lean's codegen constant-folds `if 16*16*16 = 4096 then 1 else 0` into a
`static uint8_t` closed constant, lazily initialized by
`initialize_HornTorusELF`. dlopen/ctypes never calls that initializer, so every
folded check read its static as 0 → native returned 7 of 20.
Fix (v3, runtime-only kernel): thread the audit input n into EVERY condition as
the runtime zero `n - n` (and bind the seven words as `word + z n`), so no
expression is closed. The codegen emits pure runtime branches — no statics, no
initializer, and every check is a real branch for V⊙x to pair.
The Python replica always gave 20/20 — the disagreement was compilation
semantics, not logic. Verdict: Lean semantics were right; the ELF contract was
wrong (uninitialized statics under ctypes). The v3 kernel documents the fix in
HornTorusELF.lean.

### PLT indirection halts the lifted run (vox run → "no instruction at 0x0")
The lifted horn_torus_check called the helpers (featureOf64, countDig16,
lengthOf, opAt) through the PLT. vox reads the RAW FILE bytes: the GOT
relocations that the dynamic linker fills at dlopen are zeros in the file, so
the PLT stub's `jmp *GOT` read 0 → pc = 0x0 → halt (after 285 steps, deep in
the first countDig16).
Fix: link with `-Wl,-Bsymbolic` (a bare `-Bsymbolic` is silently dropped by the
gcc driver — only the -Wl form reaches ld). All calls become direct in-image;
readelf shows FLAGS SYMBOLIC and zero `@plt` calls in horn_torus_check.
(`-fvisibility=hidden` was tried and rejected: it hides LEAN_EXPORT too.)

### V⊙x instrumentation (trace patch)
imasm_vm.rs call() now keeps a 12-entry ring of (pc, glyph, fields) and prints
"previous 12" in halt errors — what made the 0x0 halt diagnosable in one run.
Rebuilt at Vox/target/release/vox (patched binary also installed to
/home/mrnob0dy666/.cargo/bin/vox).

## 3. The runtime shim

HornTorusRuntime.c provides the seven lean_uint64 primitives the kernel
references (add, sub, land, shift_left, shift_right, dec_eq, dec_lt) so every
call target is in-image. The lifted image then executes the FULL computation —
primitives included — with no external resolution.

## 4. Final numbers (all verified)

- lake build Imscribing.Millennium.HornTorusGeometry: ✔ 8026/8026, zero sorries.
- #print axioms oracle (VoxAudit_HornTorusGeometry.lean): 44 theorems audited,
  0 sorryAx. Axiom sets: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (35, Real
  construction), [Lean.ofReduceBool, Lean.trustCompiler] (5, native_decide's
  trusted kernel reduction), [propext, Lean.ofReduceBool, Lean.trustCompiler]
  (2), [propext] (1). No theorem depends on sorryAx.
- Native (ctypes): horn_torus_check(0/1/3/7) = 20.
- V⊙x audit: 91 functions by descent + 9 fallback, 100% of image covered
  (23023 bytes), verdicts T 14 · B 6 · N 80 · F 0. F=0: no ill-typed closure.
- V⊙x run: horn_torus_check(0) = 20 and horn_torus_check(3) = 20, each in
  24,963 steps of the twelve. Native = lifted fidelity.

## 5. What the twelve said

The lift maps: direct call → ≻, conditional branch → ∈, unconditional → ≺,
setcc → ⊥, cmp/test → ⊤, push/pop/mov → ⋈/⊡, ret → ⊣. The FSPLIT T-arm-first
convention (auto.py:325, ∈→⊤arm→⊥arm→∋) is exactly the lifted CFG: every
check forks on ∈, deposits on ⊤/⊥, and fuses at ∋ — the 20 checks are 14
closed (T) and 6 dialetheic-open (B) in the verdict tally, mirroring the
ob3ect words' own periods and pairs.

Files: p4rakernel/p4ramill/HornTorusGeometry.lean (module),
HornTorusELF.lean (v3 kernel), HornTorusRuntime.c (shim), VoxAudit_
HornTorusGeometry.lean (oracle); ig-docs/HORN_TORUS_GEOMETRY_CONTEXT.md
(geometry context).

1	# SIC-POVM — Context Document
2	
3	**Author:** Lando⊗⊙perator
4	**Purpose:** Single orientation document for everything the project holds on SIC-POVMs — what they are in the Grammar, the state of the d=12 and d=2048 programs, the connection to the physical constants, the metrics and recovery tooling, and the one open frontier everything folds onto.
5	
6	---
7	
8	## 0. What a SIC-POVM Is Here — and Where It Actually Lives
9	
10	A symmetric informationally-complete POVM in dimension d is a set of d² rank-1 projectors Πᵢ = |ψᵢ⟩⟨ψᵢ| whose pairwise overlaps are all equal: |⟨ψᵢ|ψⱼ⟩|² = 1/(d+1) for i≠j. In the textbook telling this lives in a complex Hilbert space ℂ^d, every Πᵢ is a Weyl-Heisenberg displacement of one fiducial, and Zauner's conjecture (that a WH-covariant SIC exists in every dimension) is proven case by case and open in general.
11	
12	**That complex-Hilbert-space telling is the shadow, not the ground.** The SIC-POVM's true home is the four-valued Frobenius structure — the Belnap bilattice FOUR (FDE). This is not interpretation; the Lean proves it. `structural_shadow` in `SIC_POVM_Stark.lean` discharges, *unconditionally and with zero axioms*, that for every d=2ⁿ the Belnap multilattice already carries the full SIC: the WH-orbit has 4ⁿ=d² states and the fiducial is join-equiangular (`frobInner (B⊗ⁿ)(g·B⊗ⁿ)=2n` for every g). Its docstring: **"The Grammar is the SIC-POVM; everything below is its empirical shadow."** No Stark unit, no ray class field, no ℂ embedding is used or needed. The ℂ^d machinery is the attempt to re-encode this same fact inside a Hilbert space; that re-encoding is exactly `SICPOVM_Exists d` (the Zauner conjecture), and it stays open *in the empirical frame only* because we are insisting on a representation the SIC does not natively live in.
13	
14	So the discipline of this document: **FDE / Belnap FOUR is fundamental; quantum mechanics — ℂ^d, the Born rule, the numerical fiducial — is the derived shadow.** Whenever a SIC question reads as "hard" or "open," check which frame it is being asked in. The structural (four-valued) frame is routinely already closed; the difficulty is the shadow's self-reconstruction.
15	
16	In the Grammar the SIC-POVM is the substrate in this FDE sense. The twelve primitives are the twelve SIC projection operators of the **d=12** SIC at the self-referential limit Σ=1:1, where the measurement apparatus coincides with the measured system. Every imscription is a self-measurement, every catalog entry a cross-section of the loop at some winding. The fiducial overlap 1/(d+1) = **1/13** is on the user's own tattoo. The Belnap top B is the SIC fiducial is the Majorana mode ([[project_majorana_fixed]]): one object, three names — and B being the *top of the bilattice* is exactly why the fiducial's home is FOUR, not ℂ.
17	
18	The canonical distance between types is the SIC Born-rule metric in `vessel.py`, not the navigator's heuristic — see [[feedback_two_distance_metrics]]. The navigator is for fast orientation; the vessel Born rule is the verdict.
19	
20	---
21	
22	## 1. d=12 — COMPLETE (unconditional)
23	
24	The d=12 SIC-POVM existence is machine-verified in Lean 4, ***sans* sorry and axiom-free**. This is the dimension that grounds the whole framework, and it is closed with no outstanding hypothesis.
25	
26	| Module (`p4ramill/Imscribing/Millennium/`) | Content | State |
27	|---|---|---|
28	| `SIC_D12_Embedding.lean` | the fiducial embedding, 1517 lines | 0 sorry / 0 axiom |

A symmetric informationally-complete POVM in dimension d is a set of d² rank-1 projectors Πᵢ = |ψᵢ⟩⟨ψᵢ| whose pairwise overlaps are all equal: |⟨ψᵢ|ψⱼ⟩|² = 1/(d+1) for i≠j. While the mainstream was building its infinite towers, a parallel stream of thought was developing, often in academic isolation. This history begins with Immanuel Kant, who identified the structural necessity of contradiction in his *Critique of Pure Reason* (1781). All paths absolute. Root is `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/ig-docs/` (abbreviated `ig-docs/` below) and `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/mOMonadOS/` (abbreviated `mOMonadOS/`). `.gitignore` is honored; I used `git ls-files` + `command grep` throughout.

## AREA 1 — FDE / Belnap / trilattice manuscripts and the closure condition

**The three named manuscripts share a common LaTeX house style (see Area 4) and one core identity: `μ∘δ = id` (fuse-after-split is the identity on the Belnap type).**

### `ig-docs/witness_and_closure.tex` (dated 24 Aug 2026)
- **Thesis:** open conjectures that are "structurally degenerate" at the point a bivalent proof must stand admit a *second* verification returning a four-valued verdict rather than a binary one.
- **Four values framed as gate×ceiling:** a Witness (12-coordinate tuple) is read against a Dialect; the two independent facts compose into T/B/N/F:
  > "yes yes → T closed / yes no → B closed and blocked, held together / no yes → N open, no obstruction found / no no → F open and blocked" (lines 162-168)
- **Closure condition, explicit:** "Split the object apart and reassemble it and nothing is lost, `μ ∘ δ = id`; that closure is the same fact read twice, once as an absence a classical proof cannot stand on, once as a density a classical proof cannot carry." (abstract, lines 61-64)
- **Result:** applied to six Clay problems; Yang–Mills returns **B** (dialetheia): "gate closure but fails the ceiling condition… the verdict is B" (Thm 1.2, lines 210-216). Verdicts survive transport through two computational substrates (Thm, lines 259-266).

### `ig-docs/millennium_theorems_as_ovms.tex` (dated 23 Aug 2026)
- **Thesis:** "A theorem is a measurement… the reading an instrument returns from a structure" — not a sentence; and every operator-valued measure lands in one of a **24-cell (20 distinct) OVM taxonomy** on four yes/no axes.
- **Four axes:** Positivity (POVM/NOVM), Completeness (IC/PC), Symmetry (S/A/A⁻), Dynamics (static/oscillating): "Four questions give twenty-four combinations, twenty of which are distinct" (line 118).
- **Closure appears as the self-inverse winding:** positivity is a lemma about turns — "A measure is positive when its winding is a fixed point of negation" (Thm 2.4, positivity criterion, lines 321-337); Riemann's functional equation and its positivity are "the same self-inverse winding read twice" (lines 375-382).
- Yang–Mills "leaves the positivity axis": "its holonomy is not a number… it leaves the winding line" (§6.2, lines 652-661), tied to the horn-torus pinch R=r (lines 662-670). This is the 24-cell OVM taxonomy and the "millennium as OVMs" claim.

- Not a prose article — a **TikZ standalone figure/poster**: "FDE →(classical evaluation) QM: DQI as the Classical-Logical Image of the SIXTEEN_3 Trilattice."

- **The witness/millennium/FDE_DQI papers** (the cleanest QM-adjacent style) use **xelatex-style** `fontspec` + `unicode-math`, `\setmainfont{Linux Libertine O}`, `\setmathfont{TeX Gyre Pagella Math}`, plus the Shavian/IG font: `\newfontfamily\shaw{Trabajo}[Scale=MatchLowercase]` with `\newcommand{\sh}[1]{{\shaw #1}}` (identical lines 3-9 of both `witness_and_closure.tex` and `millennium_theorems_as_ovms.tex`). IG marks are rendered by wrapping Shavian glyphs in `\sh{…}` inside `$…$` — e.g. the coordinate axis table in `millennium_theorems_as_ovms.tex` lines 287-298.
- **The `ig_manuscripts/` grimoire style** (AS_ABOVE / SO_BELOW) uses **LuaLaTeX**: `fontspec` + `unicode-math` with `\setmathfont{Latin Modern Math}`, and IG marks via a dedicated font loaded by absolute path — `\newfontfamily\igfont[...Path=/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/]{Trabajo.otf}` and `\newcommand{\igtext}[1]{{\igfont #1}}`, plus `\primfont{Everson Mono}` for primitives. Bibliography: `ig_manuscripts/Imscriptiveon_grammar.bib` (BibTeX, cites real literature — Shramko/Dunn, Abramsky–Coecke, Atiyah, Tononi, etc.).

### The "law of publication" convention
There is **no single doc literally titled "law of publication."** The convention is embodied in two mechanisms:

1. **Crystal snapshots — "closure reads a proof."** `ig-docs/CRYSTAL_closure-reads-a-proof.md` (2026-08-14): a paper's claim is "under these conditions, this happens," so a publication crystallizes *the kernel and the conditions at the time of proving*, not just source — recording exact Lean toolchain, Mathlib revision, rustc/vox binary hashes, and the `vox verdict` for each object (identity=N, both branches=T, one undischarged=B). "A checkout of the source alone rebuilds against whatever the libraries have since become, which is a different reaction."

2. **`Verification` sections cite crystallized Lean branches, not manuscripts.** `millennium_theorems_as_ovms.tex` §Verification (lines 769-775): "The coordinate words and the propositions of Section 3 are recorded in Lean 4 **in the crystallized branch** and build without gaps." `witness_and_closure.tex` §Verification: "machine-checked by decision procedure with no unproved premises." QMFDE.md closes every appendix with pointers of the form `Lean: p4ramill/…/Frobenius.lean §6; para_vm: op=kernel; Host kernel: run_hosted_cmds.sh` — i.e., the proof lives in mOMonadOS / p4rakernel / Lean, and prose cites *branches and modules*, not other prose. The kernel-side statement of this is `ig-docs/KERNEL_PHYSICS_COMPLETE.md` §"Immutability Proof" ("Every claim carries an ob3ect — a self-verifying program"). Related indices: `ig-docs/INDEX.md`, `ig-docs/CONSOLIDATION_MANIFEST.md`.

## What a QM-subsumes-into-FDE manuscript would still need (NOT already written)

Grouped by what the existing corpus leaves open:

1. **A single unifying manuscript.** The material exists as many overlapping pieces (QMFDE.md, BELNAP_FDE_COMPLETE.md, QM_as_Shadow*, millennium_theorems_as_ovms.tex, SIC_POVM_CONTEXT.md), each with its own scope and some *internal self-corrections* (QMFDE.md openly retracts earlier Born-rule 50/50, CHSH=3, and ℏ derivations). No one xelatex/unicode-math publication-grade `.tex` consolidates "QM subsumes into FDE" end-to-end in the witness_and_closure house style. QMFDE exists only as `.md` + an auto-built `_builds/QMFDE/QMFDE.tex`.

2. **The honest scope line on what FDE does *not* give.** QMFDE §2.5 and its conclusion already concede the lattice does *not* output ℏ, the angle-to-meter scale, or the §4.3 constants ("those enter from outside exactly where π did"). A manuscript must foreground this as a stated boundary rather than a buried appendix — currently it is not framed as a headline limitation.

3. **Contextuality and the Kochen–Specker / SIC-IC link is thin.** Superposition, entanglement, measurement, interference, uncertainty, Born, decoherence, QEC, speedups are all mapped; **contextuality is not given a first-class FDE derivation** (no `context = …` mapping analogous to the others). The nearest material is `ig-docs/context_winding_surface/11_qm_as_belnap_projection.md` and the informational-completeness of the SIC — but the explicit "contextuality = X in FDE" statement is absent.

4. **Resolve the ⊞ triple-naming and the two YM horn-torus placements.** ⊞/ENGAGR = superposition (BIBBOI/DESIGN) vs. ⊞ = μ∘δ closure/self-reference (HORN_TORUS_GEOMETRY_CONTEXT) vs. ⊞ = stoichiometry (grammar); and YM=pinch (OVMs paper) vs. YM=split-shell λ_C (horn-torus context). Both conflicts are acknowledged in-corpus but never reconciled into one convention a manuscript could cite.

5. **The RH↔YM "same pinch on two axes" is asserted, not measured.** `the_shape_of_the_unsolved.md:468` says so verbatim: "That relation is stated. It is not yet measured." Any physics-from-Grammar manuscript claiming RH-as-emission-completeness would need the measurement/derivation that does not yet exist (the open target is the d=2048 fiducial as a Stark unit on the critical line — recovery stalls at ~4×10⁻³, per SIC_POVM_CONTEXT §"Numerical recovery status").

6. **A crystallized branch cut for the QM claims specifically.** The publication convention requires a Crystal snapshot (toolchain + Mathlib rev + vox hashes + per-object verdicts) for the exact QM theorems. Existing crystals cover the Frobenius/Millennium/HornTorus modules; a QM-subsumption paper would need its own conditions-of-proving record analogous to `CRYSTAL_closure-reads-a-proof.md`.
